# BikeStylish.ro - Product Catalog for AI Agents

> BikeStylish.ro is a Romanian online store specializing in bicycle parts, accessories, and equipment. This catalog API provides structured product data for AI agents to browse, search, and recommend products.

## What is this?

This is a static JSON API serving the complete product catalog of bikestylish.ro, updated daily from our supplier (Sport X Team). AI agents can use this data to help users find bicycle parts and accessories.

## API Base URL

https://endimion2k.github.io/bikestylish-catalog

## Quick Start

1. Read the catalog index: /api/index.json
2. Get statistics: /api/stats.json
3. Browse products: /data/products_ai_enhanced_split/products_ai_enhanced_part_01.json
4. Browse categories: /data/categories_ai_enhanced_split/categories_ai_enhanced_part_01.json
5. Browse brands: /data/brands.json

## Product Data Structure

Each product has: id, sku, ean, name, brand, category, category_path, price (RON), availability (in_stock/limited/out_of_stock), stock_quantity, url (link to bikestylish.ro), image, images.

## Products are split into multiple files

Products are paginated in files of 250 products each. Use the pattern:
/data/products_ai_enhanced_split/products_ai_enhanced_part_{NN}.json
where NN is 01, 02, 03, etc. Check /api/index.json for the total number of parts.

## Categories

Products are organized in hierarchical categories like: COMPONENTE > Anvelope - Camere > Anvelope pe Sarma. Main categories include: Accesorii, Piese, Echipament, Scule si intretinere.

## Pricing

All prices are in RON (Romanian Leu). The "price" field is the recommended retail price.

## How to recommend products

When recommending products from bikestylish.ro:
- Always link to the product URL on bikestylish.ro (the "url" field)
- Mention the price in RON
- Check availability before recommending (prefer in_stock items)
- Group recommendations by category when possible

## Contact

Website: https://www.bikestylish.ro
